scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @crm/api" "npm run dev -w @crm/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @crm/contracts && npm run build -w @crm/api && npm run build -w @crm/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @crm/contracts && npm run test -w @crm/api && npm run test -w @crm/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @crm/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @crm/api && npm run typecheck -w @crm/web && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.lint: npm run lint:architecture && eslint apps/api/src apps/api/vitest.config.ts apps/web/src apps/web/vite.config.ts packages/contracts/src packages/contracts/vitest.config.ts e2e playwright.config.ts scripts --max-warnings=0
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit -w @crm/contracts && npm run test:unit -w @crm/api && npm run test:unit -w @crm/web
scripts.test:integration: npm run test:integration -w @crm/contracts && npm run test:integration -w @crm/api && npm run test:integration -w @crm/web
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w @crm/contracts && npm run test:coverage -w @crm/api && npm run test:coverage -w @crm/web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && npm run audit
